Heat supplied per unit time is constant (dQ/dt = P).

Slope of B = ΔT / Δt = (90 - 0) / (6 - 0) = 15 °C/s

Ratio of specific heat capacities:
cA / cB = (Slope of B) / (Slope of A) = 15 / 40 = 3/8

Option (A) is the inverse ratio 8/3, while options (C) and (D) incorrectly use phase-change durations or axis values directly.
